'''Yuzzums''', or '''Yuzzumi''',<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], neckless, furred and round-bodied humanoids from the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:YuzzumRugger-TheWildlifeOfSW.png|thumb|left|Some Yuzzums had hooves rather than claws.]]
Members of the species were generally humanoid, with round bodies covered in thick fur and long, spindly limbs. Nevertheless, the species showed a great deal of genetic diversity. Some had wide, toothy mouths, while others had fangs. Their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] ranged from [[Color/Legends|black]] to yellow in color. Yuzzum feet were also variable, with some groups having hooves, some having pawlike feet, and others claws. Some Yuzzums had long, pointed [[Ear/Legends|ears]], while others had no ears to speak of. Most Yuzzums were quite tall, although shorter individuals were born occasionally. These dwarf Yuzzums were often social outcasts.

==Society and culture==
Yuzzums lived in small groups that traveled the plains of [[Endor/Legends|Endor's]] moon. They spent much of their day hunting rodents, such as [[Rugger/Legends|ruggers]], that lived in the tall grasses. Some Yuzzums had learned to domesticate the arachnoid [[Rakazzak beast/Legends|rakazzak beasts]] as mounts to aid them in the hunt. Although a few Yuzzums had no technology at all, other groups fashioned primitive spears and forked lances for use in hunting and self-defense.

[[File:Yuzzums-TheCriesOfTheTrees.jpg|thumb|left|A group of blue-furred Yuzzums worked for [[Morag]], the [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] witch, in [[Mount Thunderstone]].]]
The Yuzzums spoke a language known as [[Yuzzum (language)/Legends|Yuzzum]]. The tongue was very musical in nature, and it may have been the basis for [[Ewokese/Legends|Ewokese]]. In fact, the Yuzzums sometimes encountered the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] (as well as the other species of Endor's moon), and many Ewoks could understand the Yuzzum language. When [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was communicating with the Ewoks shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], he spoke to them using the Yuzzum language. Nevertheless, Yuzzums were not averse to eating [[Wokling/Legends|woklings]]. One group of Yuzzums served [[Morag]], the [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] witch.

[[File:Yuzzum.jpg|thumb|200px|right|A Yuzzum on the Forest Moon of Endor.]]
Yuzzums were sometimes exported as pets, despite the fact that they were sentient. Their musical language made them naturals to find work as singers. One of the performers in [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] court, [[Joh Yowza/Legends|Joh Yowza]], was a Yuzzum. Jabba once received a shipment of these creatures in lieu of payment from one of his smugglers; all of them were fed to the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] but [[Wam Lufba/Legends|Wam Lufba]], whose impressive show of marksmanship saved his life. Other Yuzzums formed colonies on other worlds around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
